about_the_game:
oGANNTo is a deck-building game based on planning. The focus of this game is to develop balance and generate the highest revenue.

Analyse the plan
Analyse the supplychain and decide which resources and techniques will produce the best results.

Set the course
Information, material and cost flows are factors that must be managed.

Utilise Employees
Specialist or Workforce are resources. They must be used efficiently.

They increase the overall goal or cause the task to fail.

Learn Techniks

Common economic methods such as overtime, extra shifts, milestones, and customer visits are used. They all contribute to the result.

Leadership Styles and Progressive Challenge

Different campaigns are run with increasing difficulty.

There are multiple methods for achieving victory.


make an attempt with

Management by Results.

Management by Objective.

Management by Motivation.
and more.

The project is currently in development.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: WindowsR 8/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX: Version 9.0
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: WindowsR 8/8.1/10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 3.0GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU / NVIDIA GeForce GTX750 or better
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX: Version 9.0

short_description: The whole game is on a Gantt chart. You'll use different employees and techniques to manage the flow. The goal is to get the customer's products through the supply chain in the best way possible and to achieve the highest possible turnover.
